title: Webb County Names Matthew Martin Executive Director of Capital Projects – Infrastructure
excerpt: Webb County has named Matthew Martin as its new Executive Director of Capital Projects – Infrastructure, the county announced Tuesday.
content:
Webb County has named Matthew Martin as its new Executive Director of Capital Projects – Infrastructure, the county announced Tuesday.

Martin brings more than seven years of expert-level public works infrastructure management, construction review and departmental oversight with Webb County, according to the announcement.

He holds a Bachelor of Science in Systems Engineering, with an emphasis in business, from Texas A&M International University. He is a Lean Six Sigma Black Belt and has passed the Professional Engineer exam in civil construction.

Martin has led advanced field analysis inspections, managed multi-million-dollar capital improvement budgets, validated high-value contractor payments and coordinated critical infrastructure initiatives across local and state agencies, including the Texas Department of Transportation.

The county wished Martin the best in his new executive leadership role as he continues to build, maintain and secure county infrastructure for the community.

Source: Webb County, Texas, Facebook, Nov. 18, 2026.
